Each snapshot directory also holds a May/June 2013 capture that is NOT listed in chunk 37 (those files are listed in chunk-26.json and chunk-27.json) and was therefore not extracted here. Clark (1989) carry stated graduation years; Karel Cool, Jack Hughes and Beck A. Taylor have none. Affiliations on it are current/later roles, not first placements. Gordy Wright (mentor), Harriet Hughes and Judy Wright are not recorded. The four Distinguished PhD Alum pages are single-person profiles with current title only (no year, program or dissertation). Carolyn Woo's affiliation changes between captures (Notre Dame dean in 2013; Catholic Relief Services President and CEO in 2014). Their navigation sidebar lists "Graduate profiles 2013/2012" names (Brendan Bonner, Alicia Barnes, etc.) under the school-wide Alumni menu with no degree stated; these look like master's/MBA profiles and are not recorded.
